title: Cleaning and Sharing Data Across Sites
audience: Basic science researchers new to AI
objectives: Inspect a local dataset for contamination and missingness.
Detect outliers by z-score and choose between removal and winsorization.
Impute and scale so two labs' preprocessing is identical.
Complete a federated training round without moving raw records.

sections.name: Simulation settings
sections.purpose: Set the size and contamination of the local dataset.
sections.how_to_use: Two sliders: sample size per institution and outlier contamination rate.

sections.name: Step 1 - Local Data Inspection
sections.purpose: Look at the data before collaborating.
sections.how_to_use: Expand the raw dataset. Note the record count, the missing-secondary-value count, and especially the maximum of the target feature, which reveals the contamination.

sections.name: Step 2 - Outlier Detection and Handling
sections.purpose: Find improbable values and decide what to do with them.
sections.how_to_use: Set the z-score threshold, read the outliers-detected metric, choose a strategy radio (remove the rows, or winsorize by capping), then tick 'Apply handling and proceed'. Steps 3 and 4 stay hidden until that box is checked.

sections.name: Step 3 - Imputation and Scaling
sections.how_to_use: Choose an imputation method (mean, median, zero) and a scaler (Min-Max, Standard). The before/after boxplots and the 'values still beyond 3 SD' metric show the effect.

sections.name: Step 4 - A Federated Learning Round
sections.purpose: Train across two institutions without moving raw data.
sections.how_to_use: Press 'Run federated learning round'. Each node's local weights, the aggregated global model, and a 'records shared = 0' metric appear. Change a preprocessing choice and run again to see the weights move.

chatbot_guidance: The scenario is aggregating immunology data across Lab Alpha and Lab Beta to analyse cytokine responses. The target feature is IL-6; the secondary feature is a T-cell count, missing in every tenth record.
The constraint that shapes the whole page: federated learning only works if every site preprocesses identically, so the agreement has to happen before the first round.
Steps 3 and 4 are gated behind the 'Apply handling and proceed' checkbox. If a learner cannot find them, that box is why.
Imputing with zero is not neutral -- a zero cell count is a biological claim, not a blank.
Every chart on this page has a 'View chart data as text (accessible alternative)' expander beneath it, holding the same numbers as a table.
